sections.Profile:
A reskin of the 1986 classic "Pin•Bot" with a space / gambling theme. Play four games of chance (with a little help from the extra ball button) to take part in the Casino Run, the ultimate risk & reward mode.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1995
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Pinbot, Gambling, Space, Original Theme, 1990s, Solid State, Pinball Franchise, Robots, Fantasy
